handheld_pipeline.input_note: The public backend reference implementation starts from an anonymized ECG array supplied by a paired app or uploader; BLE acquisition and mobile UI code are not included in this backend package.

threshold_note: Operating thresholds are deployment- and site-specific and are intentionally omitted from this public demo configuration. To enable categorical risk groups in a private deployment, add a private thresholds object with low_risk_threshold and high_risk_threshold.
training_note: Public demo outputs are continuous model scores only.
